name: Suzuki V-Strom 800DE / 800
engine: 776 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, ride-by-wire
intro: Suzuki's newer middleweight adventure bike. Early 800DEs had a rear tire recall that NHTSA flagged do-not-ride.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2023-2024 800DE and 800DE Adventure bikes are in recall 24V535 for the original rear tire.
A-002.reason: The tread can separate. Don't ride on the original rear tire until it is checked. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Original rear tire tread can separate from the tire.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear tire free.
